release_notes: Fixed mid-word Devanagari splits: added ends_at_word_boundary() safety check in should_flush() to prevent TTS cutting words like हारी into हा+री.
Fixed Nemotron STT transcribe() chunking: audio now fed as sequential 8960-sample windows with reset_state() only at end, producing coherent Devanagari Hindi transcripts.
Confirmed Supertonic emotion tag support: <laugh>, <breath>, <sigh> tags produce audibly different TTS output (verified via integration test).
Benchmark results: 100% completion (5/5 clips), 0 mid-word splits, STT RTF 0.18x (22x faster than v0.8.0 Qwen3), peak RSS ~2.5 GB.
Replaced English STT prefix removal with whitespace normalization in pipeline for cleaner transcript handling.
CPU-aware LLM thread presets: dynamically computed from navigator.hardwareConcurrency with maxSafe = totalCores - 2.
CPU governor detection: Linux startup check emits cpu_governor_warning event if not 'performance'; frontend shows dismissible banner.

linux.update_command: sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade vox
